last_assistant_message:
The plaud-ingest workflow is underway. Status so far:

**State reset**: `workflows/plaud-ingest/state.yaml` was in `status: blocked` (stuck at step-04 due to a prior osascript/Desktop Commander outage) with 116 recordings discovered and pending transcription. Per the workflow's STATE CHECK protocol (rule 5), I reset it to `in-progress` and am re-running the pipeline rather than treating the blocker as still valid.

**Now running in background**: `fetch_plaud.py --all` (in `skills/plaud-transcripts/scripts/`) against the full Plaud recording set. This single script pass covers discovery + transcription-trigger + fetch in one shot — it re-checks every recording's status, triggers transcription on anything still missing, and pulls down any transcript that's finished generating into `~/Downloads/transcript-staging/`. Given ~116 recordings needing per-item detail calls, this will take a while.

I'll pick up from there once it finishes: check for untagged speakers (step-03, may need your input on ambiguous ones), ingest ready transcripts into the Obsidian vault under `zzPlaud/` with Monday routing (step-05), and share each with Alice Mburu (step-05b). I'm not waiting on this response — I'll continue autonomously and surface speaker-ID questions or a completion summary as they come up.
